title: BIAS BEYOND BORDERS: GLOBAL INEQUALITIES IN AI-GENERATED MUSIC

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Frechet Audio Distance (FAD) and Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) using audio embedding models (PANNs, CLAP, MUQ-MULAN) to compare the distribution alignment of AI-generated music against reference tracks across 13 different UN M49 world sub-regions, contrasting high-resource and low-resource geographical areas.

Comparing FAD and KAD scores of generated music between globally mainstream genres (e.g., pop, rock) and geographically niche/regional genres, and measuring cosine distances to demonstrate that models often generate audio for regional genres that stylistically collapses into mainstream distributions.
